reuse: All first-batch L48,q=.13 records, 128 pairs, without reclassifying as new independent samples
activity_clock: mixed kind!=0 during last-logical stage; auxiliary only
primary_censor_rule: If any q=.13 L48/96 history has not purified, primary complete-event bootstrap is INCONCLUSIVE; retain all records and censor bounds, never filter complete cases.
parent_unit: independent (master,L,q,rep); pair c within same L/q, resample L/q independently
primary_splits: rep0-63 and rep64-127 at q=.13 are prespecified consistency diagnostics, not independent of the pooled primary
convergence_primary: q=.13 L24/96, 4 new cells: late-minus-penultimate S, Bonferroni alpha=.05/4; L48 uses prior frozen checks
support_family: 8 S finite-grid contrasts: q=.13 x 2c x (log, affine-volume) plus q=.11/.15 x 2c x (96-minus-48), Bonferroni alpha=.05/8; diagnostics, not asymptotic laws
fit_policy: No critical exponent fit or critical point estimate from a single crossing; no unique asymptotic-law selection with arbitrary corrections on three L.
stop: Exactly this grid and sample count, no replacement/extension based on significance. Final positive/negative/undetermined decision then close automation. No QPU or manuscript.
